newsitem.title: USA: CSCE sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were called to open mostly unchanged Tuesday, dealers said, with activity seen rangebound throughout the day.
Monday, benchmark October sugar settled at 11.82 cents a lb, down 0.04 cent, having ranged from 11.89 to 11.72 cents. The rest closed 0.01 to 0.06 cent lower.
Nearby chart resistance was pegged at 11.93 cents followed by 12.00 cents for October. Steady producer prices is expected to limit gains.
The October/March spread closed unchanged at 0.18 cent.

In fundamental news, hot dry weather over the past two weeks has been ideal for the French beet crop. In central France, thunderstorms were bringing the crops relief from the scorching temperatures, an analyst for the French sugar beet planters federation said.

LIFFE white sugar futures were down slightly on Tuesday but the benchmark October contract remained well-supported over its downside target of $326.00, amid commission house buying. At 0845 EDT/1245 GMT, the contract stood 20 cents lower at $326.20, and the rest of the board was trading unchanged to 40 cents weaker.
